source_policy: Use primary records first; fill remaining quota from fallback without replacement

sampling.quota_allocation: Proportional largest remainder; ties sorted by disease/severity
sampling.within_stratum: Ascending SHA-256 of seed + NUL + department + NUL + record_id
sampling.output_order: Source priority, then original source line order

record_transformations: None; source JSON text is retained with LF line endings
